original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

# Create Task for Directory Deletion
aos_manager.create_task(
    tick=207,
    description="Investigate and implement a method for directory deletion in AOS utility scripts (e.g., using `shutil.rmtree`).",
    parent_id=25 # Parent task for AOS development
)

# Logging
TICK_TO_LOG = 206
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="storage_delete", target="redundant_directory", metadata={"status": "failed", "reason": "Cannot delete directories"})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="submit", target="AOS Admin: Task for Workflow Improvement", metadata={"eval_id": 497})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="storage_write", target="repro_gen5.py", metadata={})
aos_manager.log_structured_action(tick=TICK_TO_LOG, type="submit", target="AOS Live Use: Log Tick 205 Actions (Corrected)", metadata={"eval_id": 498})
